title: 盛学CEO罗斯曼：美国限制反而加速中国AI创新，对话比不谈好
speaker: Andy Rothman

segments.en: Yeah, I've spent the last two weeks on in mainland China a lot of that time talking to Chinese investors in Chinese AI and robotics
segments.zh: 是的，我过去两周在中国内地，大部分时间都在与中国AI和机器人领域的投资者交流。

segments.en: And I think I took away two things the most important thing I think for investors is that every time
segments.zh: 我认为我得到了两点收获，对投资者来说最重要的一点是，每次

segments.en: The US government tries to use export controls and other restrictions to slow down progress in Chinese technology sectors
segments.zh: 美国政府试图利用出口管制和其他限制来减缓中国科技领域的进展

segments.en: It just ends up accelerating domestic innovation and we're seeing the same thing now and chips
segments.zh: 结果反而加速了国内创新，我们现在在芯片领域也看到了同样的情况。

segments.en: We're seeing the same thing now and robots and in AI
segments.zh: 我们在机器人和AI领域也看到了同样的情况。

segments.en: The second thing is when it comes to an agreement between the two countries
segments.zh: 第二点是，当涉及两国之间的协议时

segments.en: It's great that they're talking about it and they're going to announce some kind of dialogue
segments.zh: 他们谈论这件事并宣布某种对话是好事

segments.en: But I think it's going to be really challenging to turn that dialogue into anything productive in part because
segments.zh: 但我认为要将对话转化为任何有成果的东西将非常具有挑战性，部分原因是

segments.en: I don't think the US government yet knows what its own internal policy is about AI safety
segments.zh: 我认为美国政府还不知道自己对AI安全的内部政策是什么。

segments.en: So how do they negotiate with the Chinese on that but still talking is better than not talking
segments.zh: 那么他们如何就此与中国谈判？但谈总比不谈好。
